title: Leviathan
problem: Same as Beelzebub: only "killer has Leviathan" is checked, no side test, so killing an ally also gives the 5 stacks of each Lesser Demon. Text says "kills an enemy".
notes: Community claim: Triggers when the master kills any creature, not only an enemy; works with Anger Management. Evidence: bc_OnDeath L981 @0x1414c1cd0: [killer] > -1 @0x1414c1cf0 && scr_CritHasCondition(killer, 57) @0x1414c1e7d. Fix sketch: T: "kills a creature", or H: add side test Triage 2026-10-26: Ruling 2026-10-26 (stat/scope/trigger wording): text matches code. Triggers on any kill (no side test). 2026-10-26: text correction shipped via localization_override (loader text module). | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "master kills an enemy". Fix: H: same as SU-0124 on scr_CritHasCondition(killer, 57) in bc_OnDeath L981 (@0x1414c1e7d). vs bugged: weaker. 2026-10-26 hook batch E built (research/hooks_E.json, loader/hooks_E.c). In-game test: Master with Leviathan; kill an ALLY: no Lesser Demon stacks. Kill an enemy: 5 stacks of each Lesser Demon.

release_notes.intended: Triggers when its master kills an enemy.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, any kill triggered it, allies included.
release_notes.fix: Now only kills of enemies trigger it.
